    const menuSection = menu.querySelector('.ctmenu-section');

        // Check if click is on a dropdown title

            const hasChildren = dropdownTitle.closest('.ctmenu-item-has-children');
            const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 991;

                toggleMobileDropdown(hasChildren);

            if (isMobile) {

            } else {
                // Desktop: Show dropdown on hover
                showSubMenu(hasChildren);
            }
        }
    });

        hideSubMenu();
    });

    menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggleMenu();
    });

    menuClosed.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggleMenu();
    });

    menuOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggleMenu();
    });

    // Show & Hide Toggle Menu Function
    function toggleMenu() {
        menu.classList.toggle('active');
        menuOverlay.classList.toggle('active');
    }

    function toggleMobileDropdown(hasChildren) {
        const title = hasChildren.querySelector('.ch_li_title');
        const subMenu = hasChildren.querySelector('.ctmenu-subs');
        
        if (subMenu.classList.contains('active')) {
            subMenu.classList.remove('active');
            title.classList.remove('active');
            menu.querySelector('.ctmenu-mobile-ctheader').classList.remove('active');
            menu.querySelector('.ctmenu-mobile-title').innerHTML = '';
            
            // Special handling for Industries dropdown
            if (hasChildren.querySelector('.industriewidth')) {

                resetIndustryDropdown(industryContainer);
            }

            // Close any other open dropdowns first
            closeAllMobileDropdowns();
            
            // Open this dropdown

        allSubMenus.forEach(subMenu => {
            subMenu.classList.remove('active');

            title.classList.remove('active');
        });
        
        menu.querySelector('.ctmenu-mobile-ctheader').classList.remove('active');
        menu.querySelector('.ctmenu-mobile-title').innerHTML = '';

            panel.classList.remove('active');
            panel.style.display = 'none';
        });
        
        // Show industry types section
        const industryLeft = container.querySelector('.industry-left');
        if (industryLeft) {
            industryLeft.style.display = 'flex';
            industryLeft.style.visibility = 'visible';
            industryLeft.classList.add('mobile-industry-types');
        }
        
        // Hide industry details section
        const industryRight = container.querySelector('.cnflex.fwidth.industry-panel');
        if (industryRight) {
            industryRight.style.display = 'none';
            industryRight.style.visibility = 'hidden';
            industryRight.classList.remove('mobile-show-details');

        leftItems.forEach(item => {
            item.classList.remove('active');
        });
        
        // Remove any mobile industry details
        const existingDetails = container.querySelectorAll('.mobile-industry-details');
        existingDetails.forEach(detail => detail.remove());

        const leftItems = container.querySelectorAll('.industry-left .list-item[data-index]');
        leftItems.forEach(item => {
            item.classList.remove('active');

                item.classList.add('active');
                
                // Get the target panel content
                const targetPanel = container.querySelector(`.industry-panel[data-index="${industryType}"]`);
                if (targetPanel) {

                    const detailsDiv = targetPanel.cloneNode(true);
                    detailsDiv.classList.add('mobile-industry-details');

                    item.parentNode.insertBefore(detailsDiv, item.nextSibling);
